attempts.summary: Implemented via Ansible (control node2 → target node1): blacklisted the usb_storage kernel module on node1 persistently and unloaded it now. ansible-core 2.20's Python-based modules are incompatible with RHEL7's python2-only interpreter (python3 not installable, no repos), so the playbook uses ansible.builtin.raw tasks over SSH to write /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf ("blacklist usb_storage" + "install usb_storage /bin/false") and unload the module if loaded. Verified module absent and explicit modprobe blocked with "Operation not permitted", both before and after a full reboot of node1. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol for both node1 and node2, confirming new boot_id on each and full functional recovery (module still blacklisted on node1; Ansible control still works from node2).
